product_metadata.title: Kenney KN724 Rogers Twist & Fit No Tools Easy to Install Tension Curtain Rod, 48-84" Adjustable Length, White Finish, 5/8" Diameter Steel Tube
features: The Kenney Rogers 5/8" Twist & Fit No Tools Tension Window Curtain Rod installs quickly and easily – just Twist & Fit!
The telescoping rod is adjustable from 48-84" to accommodate your window
The steel rod in white finish is ideal for light to medium weight curtains in your bedroom or living room
Non-slip, non-scratch end caps help protect your window frame from damage
description: The Kenney Rogers 5/8" Twist & Fit No Tools Tension Window Curtain Rod installs quickly and easily with no tools or damage to your walls – just Twist & Fit!

The telescoping metal rod adjusts from 48 inches to 84 inches in length to fit your window. The 5/8 inch diameter tension rod is recommended for use with light to medium weight curtains in your bedroom or living room. Whether you rent or own, the Kenney Rogers 5/8" Twist & Fit No Tools Tension Window Curtain Rod is the best solution for damage free installation while hanging curtains. The non-slip, non-scratch end caps mean no damage to your wall or tile, making this a great solution for rentals or other temporary installments.
Twist and Fit No Tools tension technology makes installation easy. To install, extend against both walls at an angle, twist to lock, and level rod into place.
